title: FEAT — /posted <tiktok_url> shortcut: auto-record last video with URL
rationale: Queue empty. Operator friction: after posting to TikTok, operator must type '/record <id> 0 <url>' — requires knowing video_id. The /posted command already auto-detects last delivered video_id but doesn't accept a URL arg. Fix: /posted <tiktok_url> saves the URL with the entry, reducing friction to one copy-paste.

tasks.description: Modify cmdPosted() in scripts/telegram-commands/cmd-content.ts to accept an optional url arg. If provided, save tiktok_url in the manual-posts.jsonl entry. Also update the success message to confirm URL was saved. Also update telegram-bot.ts to pass cmdArgs to cmdPosted(args).
